info.name: Employee Self-Service API
info.description: Run folder 0 first to sign in as each seeded role; every request then sends the right JWT. Folders follow the workflows and rejected actions in the capstone brief.

item.name: 0 - Sign in (run first)
item.description: Uses the seeded sample accounts. Set the {{password}} variable (default Password123!).

item.name: Deactivate employee (their JWT is then rejected with 401)
REJECTED: HR/other manager decides at manager stage (403)
HR: confirm + generate allowance (days x rate)
Staff: submit completion evidence (after training end date)
3 - Learning
Staff: content (questions have no answer key)
Staff: submit assessment (server scores; client score ignored)

item.description: Replace {{questionId}} / {{correctOptionId}} with the ids from the /content response.

item.name: HR: create Draft plan for staff1
REJECTED: HR creates plan for themselves (403)
HR: activate (reviewer defaults to reporting manager)
REJECTED: another employee changes the plan (403)
HR: reopen Active/Returned plan with future deadline
REJECTED: invalid status move Shortlisted -> Submitted (409)
